name: Yumemishi
source:
Hirou lives with his grandmother, Tose. One day, he notices the things happened yesterday are happening again. It seems he lives the same day twice. The most beautiful girl at his school, Natsuko. A cheerful girl, Nao. And a mysterious girl, Sakuya. As a day rolls on, they gradually become important to him....
